item.title: DGCA orders immediate on-site inspections at 11 airports after IndiGo disruptions
item.description: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) on Wednesday ordered immediate on-site inspections at eleven airports across the country after widespread passenger inconvenience caused by large-scale disruptions in IndiGo’s operations. These airports include Nagpur, Jaipur, Bhopal, Surat, Tirupati, Vijayawada, Shirdi, Cochin, Lucknow, Amritsar and Dehradun. item.title: 2 buildings collapse in Morocco's Fez, at least 19 dead: Report
item.description: At least 19 people died and at least a dozen were others injured after two buildings collapsed in Morocco's Fez city early on Wednesday, AFP news agency reported, citing Maghreb Arab Press Agency, the Moroccan news agency. The incident occurred in the Fez prefecture after two adjacent four-storey buildings collapsed on the intervening night of Tuesday and Wednesday. item.title: Ahmedabad Civil Hospital records 163 eye cancer cases in children in 5 years
item.description: Over the past five years, Ahmedabad Civil Hospital has recorded 163 cases of eye cancer in children. Children below the age of five, who start experiencing difficulty in identifying colours, develop a white glow in the eyes, show swelling around the eyes, or begin to lose vision, should be examined immediately. item.title: Junior Women’s World Cup: India Beat Uruguay In Shootout After 1-1 Draw
item.description: In Hockey, India defeated Uruguay 3-1 in a shootout after an intense 1-1 draw in their qualification match for 9th to 12th positions at the FIH Hockey Junior Women’s World Cup 2025 in Santiago, last night. item.title: Amazon, Microsoft pledge mega AI investments in India
item.description: Tech giants Amazon and Microsoft have announced a combined $52.5bn (£39.4bn) investment plan for India over the coming years.
